title: Practice 20: Since, till, by, before, after

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: С ___ (эта минута) здоровье стало возвращаться.
exercises.why: «С + Gen. meaning "from" or "since".» — DLI, Lesson 76.

exercises.q: Таких „очевидцев“ до ___ (наши дни) сменилось бы только...
exercises.why: «ДО + Gen. meaning "till" (indicating a time limit of an action).» — DLI, Lesson 76.
